notablePrerequisites: It can be either day or night.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tovolar's Huntmaster, adding {C}{C}.
Tovolar's Huntmaster dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Tovolar's Huntmaster from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Tovolar's Huntmaster enters the battlefield, creating two 2/2 Wolf creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
